title: Leadership Principles: Under, Just Right, Over
source: Kindel interviewer calibration tool. Classic 14 leadership principles. Rewritten from an internal raises/lowers wiki; company, product, and exec references removed.
howTo: Use this when you are writing a loop, sitting in a debrief, or coaching someone who is over-rotating on a principle.
Under is not trying. Over is the principle eating the job. Just Right is the bar.
I want interviewers to score the story against a row, not against a vibe. Pick the situation that matches what you heard, then say under, just right, or over, and write the evidence.
Cross-refs look like {lp:ownership}. Render them as links. Agents treat them as hard links to that principle file.
These files pair with data/questions.json. Same ids. Do not add competency-cut principles here.

crossRef.render: Replace the token with a link to that LP. Agents treat tokens as hard links.
